# @astrake/lumora-webserver — Full AI & Developer Specification (`v0.1.2`)

> `@astrake/lumora-webserver` is the brand-neutral website framework of the Lumora ecosystem. It pairs a zero-dependency headless PHP 8.2+ micro-kernel (`Lumora\Core`, with legacy `Astrake\Lumora\Core` alias) with a Bun/TypeScript CLI (`lumora-web`) that compiles Tailwind CSS v4 + brand layers, locks SHA-256 and SHA-384 Subresource Integrity (SRI) checksums in `lumora-lock.json`, verifies 12 automated security/compliance gates, and packages a standalone `dist/` bundle with physical `<route>/index.php` stubs for Apache, Nginx, cPanel, and aaPanel.

---

## 1. Repository & Consumer Directory Layouts

### 1.1. `LumoraWebServer` Monorepo Layout
```text
LumoraWebServer/
├── VERSION                               # Single source of truth for package version (0.1.2)
├── package.json                          # Bun workspace root (packages/*, apps/*)
├── tsconfig.base.json                    # Shared strict TypeScript configuration
├── AGENTS.md                             # AI Coding Agent operating rules & API quick-reference
├── llms.txt                              # LLM index manifest
├── llms-full.txt                         # Full single-file LLM specification
├── docs/                                 # User and Developer documentation suite
│   ├── PROJECT.md
│   ├── ARCHITECTURE.md
│   ├── user/
│   │   ├── GETTING_STARTED.md
│   │   ├── CONFIGURATION.md
│   │   └── DEPLOYMENT.md
│   └── developer/
│       ├── CONTRIBUTING.md
│       └── TESTING.md
├── tools/                                # Release & workspace automation scripts
│   ├── build.ts                          # Builds packages/core + apps/starter/dist
│   ├── check.ts                          # Runs tsc across all workspace packages
│   ├── version.ts                        # Syncs VERSION across all package.json manifests
│   ├── changelog.ts                      # Generates conventional-commit CHANGELOG.md entries
│   └── validate.ts                       # Full CI gate: check -> test -> build -> verify -> version:sync
├── packages/
│   └── core/                             # Published @astrake/lumora-webserver NPM package
│       ├── package.json
│       ├── bin/lumora-web.ts             # CLI entrypoint
│       ├── src/
│       │   ├── index.ts                  # Main package export (types + cli)
│       │   ├── types/
│       │   │   ├── config.ts             # LumoraWebConfigSchema & LumoraLockfile
│       │   │   ├── inquiry.ts            # LumoraInquiryWirePayloadSchema & HMAC helpers
│       │   │   └── index.ts
│       │   └── cli/
│       │       ├── paths.ts              # Runtime locator, SHA-256/SHA-384 helpers, evalPhpJson
│       │       ├── sync.ts               # Copies runtime/php/core & lumora-core.js + writes lumora-lock.json
│       │       ├── css-compiler.ts       # Compiles Tailwind v4 + brand layers -> lumora.min.css
│       │       ├── build-dist.ts         # Assembles standalone dist/ + physical route stubs
│       │       ├── verify.ts             # 12-Gate Automated Compliance Verifier
│       │       ├── dev.ts                # Local php -S server + CSS watcher
│       │       ├── flush.ts              # CLI replay of pending SQLite WAL outbox rows
│       │       ├── init.ts               # Project scaffolder
│       │       └── index.ts
│       ├── runtime/
│       │   ├── php/
│       │   │   ├── core/                 # 13 headless PHP 8.2+ modules
│       │   │   └── stubs/                # index.stub.php, router.stub.php, htaccess.stub.conf, nginx.stub.conf
│       │   ├── css/lumora-base.css       # Tailwind v4 base entry + @theme + focus/reduced-motion/honeypot rules
│       │   └── js/lumora-core.js         # Shared client ES module
│       └── test/                         # Bun + PHP integration tests
└── apps/
    └── starter/                          # Dogfooding reference website (lumora-web-starter)
```

### 1.2. Consumer Brand Website Layout
```text
<brand-website>/
├── package.json                          # devDependencies: { "@astrake/lumora-webserver": "^0.1.2" }
├── lumora.config.php                     # Declarative brand, security, asset, hub, legal, and feature config
├── lumora-lock.json                      # Auto-generated SHA-256 core lock + SHA-384 asset SRI map
├── index.php                             # Canonical front controller (synced from index.stub.php)
├── router.php                            # Local dev server router for `php -S` (excluded from dist/)
├── .htaccess                             # Apache / LiteSpeed / cPanel hardening & routing
├── core/                                 # Read-only PHP 8.2+ runtime managed by `lumora-web sync`
├── css/
│   ├── brand-theme.css                   # Brand @theme tokens (colors, fonts, radii, shadows)
│   └── brand.css                         # Brand component & utility rules
├── content/
│   ├── routes.php                        # Static route map & 301 redirect table
│   ├── channels.php                      # Multi-channel contact/demo form schema & field rules
│   ├── legal/{slug}.php                  # Optional per-document legal overrides/addenda
│   ├── docs/manifest.json                # Optional documentation tracks & Markdown articles
│   └── blog/{slug}.php                   # Optional blog post definitions
├── public/
│   ├── assets/css/lumora.min.css         # Compiled Tailwind v4 + brand CSS (SRI locked)
│   ├── assets/js/lumora-core.js          # Synced client ES module (SRI locked)
│   ├── fonts/*.woff2                     # Self-hosted WOFF2 fonts (auto-preloaded with SRI)
│   └── brand/*                           # Brand icons, logos, OpenGraph images
├── templates/
│   ├── layout/{head,header,footer}.php   # Brand layout partials
│   └── {home,contact,legal,404,...}.php  # Brand page templates
├── storage/                              # Runtime Vault (403 blocked via .htaccess & index.php)
│   ├── csrf-secret.php                   # Auto-generated 256-bit HMAC secret
│   └── vault-<32hex>/
│       ├── lumora.sqlite                 # SQLite3 WAL database (contact_submissions, contact_rate_limits)
│       ├── contacts-backup.jsonl         # Atomic flock JSONL failover ledger
│       └── security-events.log           # Security rate-limit & audit event log
└── dist/                                 # Standalone zero-dependency production bundle (`lumora-web build`)
```

## 2. Declarative Configuration Contracts

### 2.1. `lumora.config.php`
```php
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!defined('LUMORA_BOOTSTRAPPED')) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Forbidden');
}

return [
    'brand' => [
        'id'                            => 'acme',             // Lowercase identifier
        'prefix'                        => 'ACM',              // Receipt prefix -> ACM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX
        'name'                          => 'Acme Studio',
        'short_name'                    => 'Acme',
        'legal_entity'                  => 'Acme Studio LLC',  // Optional legal operator name
        'expose_legal_entity_in_schema' => false,              // Emit legalName on Organization JSON-LD
        'expose_legal_entity_in_llms'   => false,              // Include legal_entity in /llms.txt
        'schema_org_type'               => 'Organization',     // 'Organization' | 'Person' | 'LocalBusiness'
        'framework_label'               => 'lumora-webserver', // Label returned in /health
        'domain'                        => 'acme.example.com',
        'origin'                        => 'https://acme.example.com',
        'version'                       => '0.1.2',
        'locale'                        => 'en',
        'theme_color'                   => '#0a0a0a',
        'background_color'              => '#ffffff',
        'color_scheme'                  => 'light',            // 'light' | 'dark'
        'primary_offering_schema'       => false,              // Emit SoftwareApplication JSON-LD node
        'emit_brand_node'               => false,              // Emit standalone Brand JSON-LD node
        'category'                      => 'BusinessApplication',
        'operating_system'              => 'Web, Linux, Windows, macOS',
        'slogan'                        => 'Fast, resilient static-first websites.',
        'description'                   => 'Example site configuration for @astrake/lumora-webserver.',
        'contact_email'                 => 'contact@acme.example.com',
        'security_email'                => 'security@acme.example.com',
        'logo'                          => '/public/brand/icon.svg',
        'og_image'                      => '/public/brand/og-default.png',
        'same_as'                       => [],
        'contact_points'                => [],
        'address'                       => [],                 // Optional: street, locality, region, postal_code, country
    ],
    'security' => [
        'canonical_https_redirect' => true,
        'strip_www_redirect'       => true,
        'trust_proxy_headers'      => false, // Set true behind Cloudflare / local Nginx reverse proxy
        'csp_style_unsafe_inline'  => true,
        'csp_media_self'           => false,
        'rate_limit_max_attempts'  => 5,
        'rate_limit_window_sec'    => 900,
        'csrf_ttl_sec'             => 7200,
        'compat_constants'         => [], // Opt-in legacy constant names (/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}$/)
    ],
    'assets' => [
        'compiled_css' => '/public/assets/css/lumora.min.css',
        'core_js'      => '/public/assets/js/lumora-core.js',
        'fonts'        => [
            '/public/fonts/inter-latin.woff2',
        ],
        'vendor_js'    => [],
    ],
    'hub' => [
        'enabled'         => false,
        'endpoint'        => getenv('LUMORA_HUB_ENDPOINT') ?: '',
        'shared_secret'   => getenv('LUMORA_HUB_SECRET') ?: '', // Or storage/hub-secret.php
        'timeout_ms'      => 1500,
        'fallback_notify' => true,
    ],
    'legal' => [
        'territories'         => ['GLOBAL'],          // 'IN' | 'EU' | 'UK' | 'US' | 'GLOBAL'
        'slugs'               => ['privacy', 'terms'], // Or auto-discovered + custom content/legal/*.php
        'include_default_slugs' => true,
        'entity_type'         => '',
        'grievance_officer'   => '',
        'grievance_email'     => 'contact@acme.example.com',
        'effective_date'      => '2026-11-10',
        'retention_days_pii'  => 90,   // Set 0 or null to disable automated PII redaction
        'retention_days_logs' => 180,  // Set 0 or null to disable automated log purge
        'governing_law'       => '',
    ],
    'discovery' => [
        'robots_txt'    => true,
        'sitemap_xml'   => true,
        'llms_txt'      => true,
        'llms_full_txt' => true,
        'security_txt'  => true, // Defaults auto from security_email / .well-known/security.txt if omitted
        'webmanifest'   => true,
    ],
    'features' => [
        'docs_engine'    => true,
        'blog_engine'    => true,
        'release_server' => false,
        'legal_registry' => true,
        'inquiry_engine' => true,
    ],
];
```

### 2.2. `content/routes.php`
```php
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!defined('LUMORA_BOOTSTRAPPED')) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Forbidden');
}

return [
    'routes' => [
        '/' => [
            'template'   => 'home',
            'priority'   => '1.0',
            'changefreq' => 'weekly',
            'meta'       => [
                'title'       => 'Brand Name — Headline',
                'description' => 'Page meta description.',
                'path'        => '/',
                'schema_type' => 'home', // 'home' | 'contact' | 'docs' | 'blog' | 'legal'
                'faq'         => [
                    ['q' => 'Question?', 'a' => 'Answer.'],
                ],
            ],
        ],
        '/contact/' => [
            'template' => 'contact',
            'meta'     => [
                'title'       => 'Contact — Brand Name',
                'description' => 'Direct inquiry and statutory rights desk.',
                'path'        => '/contact/',
                'schema_type' => 'contact',
            ],
        ],
    ],
    'redirects' => [
        '/privacy'  => '/legal/privacy/',
        '/privacy/' => '/legal/privacy/',
        '/terms'    => '/legal/terms/',
        '/terms/'   => '/legal/terms/',
    ],
];
```

### 2.4. `content/legal/{slug}.php` (Custom Document & Territory Merge Contract)
Built-in baseline slugs: `privacy`, `terms`, `cookies`, `accessibility`, `security`, `company` (defaults to `['privacy', 'terms']` with optional arbitrary custom slugs).
```php
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!defined('LUMORA_BOOTSTRAPPED')) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Forbidden');
}

return [
    'merge_territory'  => true, // When true on built-in slugs, merges onto territory baseline
    'title'            => 'Privacy Policy',
    'prepend_sections' => [],
    'replace_sections' => [
        // Override specific baseline section by ID ('architecture', 'fiduciary', 'processing', 'retention', 'rights')
    ],
    'append_sections'  => [
        [
            'id'    => 'local-vault',
            'title' => '6. Local Storage Guarantee',
            'body'  => '<p>Submissions are written locally to an isolated SQLite WAL database.</p>',
        ],
    ],
];
```

## 3. Headless PHP Core Reference (`Lumora\Core`, with `Astrake\Lumora\Core` alias)

1. **`Bootstrap`**:
   - `Bootstrap::init(string $rootDir): array`: Loads `lumora.config.php`, sets `$GLOBALS['lumoraConfig']` and `$GLOBALS['lumoraRootDir']`, boots `Security` and `Render`.
   - `Bootstrap::handleRequest(string $rootDir): void`: Executes the complete HTTP request lifecycle.
2. **`Security`**:
   - `Security::boot(array $config, string $rootDir): void`: Defines any opt-in `security.compat_constants` matching `/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}$/`, suppresses `display_errors` outside localhost, enforces canonical HTTPS/non-www `301` redirect, generates 128-bit CSP nonce, and emits 8 security headers.
   - `Security::cspNonce(): string` / `lumora_csp_nonce(): string`
   - `Security::csrfToken(?string $rootDir = null, int $now = 0): string` / `lumora_csrf_token(): string`
   - `Security::verifyCsrf(?string $rootDir, ?string $token, int $now = 0): bool` / `lumora_verify_csrf(?string $token): bool`
   - `Security::clientIpHash(?string $rootDir = null): string` / `lumora_client_ip_hash(): string`
   - `Security::vaultDir(?string $rootDir = null): string`
3. **`Router`**:
   - `Router::basePath(?string $rootDir = null): string` / `lumora_base_path(): string`
   - `Router::url(string $path, ?string $basePath = null): string` / `u(string $path): string`
   - `Router::resolve(string $rawPath, array $config, string $rootDir): array`
4. **`Discovery`**:
   - `Discovery::tryServe(string $path, array $config, string $rootDir, string $basePath = ''): bool`
   - `Discovery::isEndpointEnabled(string $key, array $config, string $rootDir): bool`
5. **`Render`**:
   - `Render::escape(?string $value): string` / `e(?string $value): string`
   - `Render::assetUrl(string $assetPath, ?string $rootDir = null): string` / `asset_url(string $path): string`
   - `Render::assetSri(string $assetPath, ?string $rootDir = null): string` / `asset_sri(string $path): string`
   - `Render::component(string $name, array $props = [], ?string $rootDir = null): void` / `component(string $name, array $props = []): void`
   - `Render::renderTemplate(string $templateName, array $context = [], ?string $rootDir = null): void` / `render_template(string $name, array $ctx = []): void`
   - `Render::headMeta(array $meta = [], ?array $config = null, ?string $rootDir = null): string` / `lumora_head_meta(array $meta = []): string`
   - `Render::coreScriptTag(?array $config = null, ?string $rootDir = null): string` / `lumora_core_script(): string`
6. **`InquiryEngine`**:
   - `InquiryEngine::handle(?array $config = null, ?string $rootDir = null, ?array $postInput = null, int $nowOverride = 0): array` / `lumora_handle_inquiry(?array $postInput = null): array`
   - Return shape:
     ```php
     [
         'submitted'       => bool,
         'success'         => bool,
         'receipt'         => string, // e.g. "LUM-20261110-3D1A"
         'reference_id'    => string, // Alias of receipt
         'db_id'           => ?int,
         'channel'         => string,
         'channel_label'   => string,
         'channel_meta'    => array,
         'sla_window'      => string,
         'timestamp'       => string,
         'created_at'      => string, // ISO-8601 UTC
         'name'            => string,
         'email'           => string,
         'return_contact'  => string,
         'details'         => array<string, string>,
         'attribution'     => array<string, string>, // First-party UTM & CTA fields when present
         'email_status'    => 'sent'|'skipped'|'failed'|'pending',
         'whatsapp_status' => 'sent'|'skipped'|'failed'|'pending',
         'sync_status'     => 'synced'|'skipped'|'pending'|'failed',
         'hub_signature'   => string, // "sha256=<hex>"
         'errors'          => array<int, string>,
         'field_errors'    => array<string, string>,
         'data'            => array<string, mixed>,
         'values'          => array<string, mixed>,
     ]
     ```

---

## 4. TypeScript Exports & Cross-Language HMAC Wire Protocol

### 4.1. Package Entrypoints
- `@astrake/lumora-webserver`: Re-exports `./types` and `./cli`.
- `@astrake/lumora-webserver/types`:
  - `LumoraWebConfigSchema`, `LumoraBrandConfigSchema`, `LumoraSecurityConfigSchema`, `LumoraAssetsConfigSchema`, `LumoraDiscoveryConfigSchema`, `LumoraHubSyncConfigSchema`, `LumoraLegalConfigSchema`, `LumoraFeaturesConfigSchema`, `type LumoraWebConfig`, `type LumoraLockfile`.
  - `LumoraInquiryRecordSchema`, `LumoraInquiryWirePayloadSchema`, `LumoraAttributionSchema`, `type LumoraInquiryRecord`, `type LumoraInquiryWirePayload`.
  - `signLumoraWebhookPayload(rawBody: string, timestamp: string | number, secret: string): string`
  - `verifyLumoraWebhookSignature(rawBody: string, timestamp: string, signatureHeader: string, secret: string, maxAgeSeconds?: number): boolean`
- `@astrake/lumora-webserver/cli`:
  - `initWebsite`, `syncWebsite`, `compileBrandCss`, `buildWebsiteDist`, `verifyWebsite`, `runDevServer`, `flushOutbox`.

### 4.2. HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Wire Protocol
When `hub.enabled` is `true`, `HubClient::syncInquiryToHub()` sends `POST <hub.endpoint>` with:
- Headers:
  - `Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8`
  - `X-Lumora-Brand: <brand.id>`
  - `X-Lumora-Timestamp: <unix_epoch_seconds>`
  - `X-Lumora-Idempotency-Key: <receipt_id>`
  - `X-Lumora-Signature: sha256=<hex_hmac_sha256(timestamp + "." + rawJsonBody, shared_secret)>`
- Body: Validated by `LumoraInquiryWirePayloadSchema`.

---

## 5. 12-Gate Automated Compliance Verifier (`lumora-web verify`)

1. **Gate 01 — Core Lock Integrity (SHA-256):** Verifies zero drift between `core/*.php` + `public/assets/js/lumora-core.js` and `lumora-lock.json`, and ensures no untracked `.php` files exist in `core/`.
2. **Gate 02 — PHP 8.2+ Syntax & Strict Types:** Validates syntax via `TOKEN_PARSE` + `php -l` and asserts `declare(strict_types=1);` in every `.php` file.
3. **Gate 03 — `LUMORA_BOOTSTRAPPED` Direct-Access Isolation:** Asserts every `.php` file outside `index.php` and `router.php` checks `!defined('LUMORA_BOOTSTRAPPED')` and exits `403`.
4. **Gate 04 — Font & Vendor Asset SRI SHA-384 Synchronization:** Asserts `lumora.min.css`, `lumora-core.js`, and all `.woff2` fonts in `public/fonts/` match their `sha384-...` hashes in `lumora-lock.json`.
5. **Gate 05 — Zero Third-Party Leaks (First-Party Security):** Scans all `.php`, `.css`, and `.js` files for external font/script CDNs, analytics trackers, `eval()`, and `new Function()`.
6. **Gate 06 — Design Token & Accessibility Audit:** Verifies `lumora.min.css` is non-empty and includes `prefers-reduced-motion` and `:focus-visible`, and every `<img>` in `templates/` has `width`, `height`, and `alt`.
7. **Gate 07 — Canonical Route & Trailing-Slash Audit:** Validates all routes in `content/routes.php` use trailing slashes and resolve to existing `templates/*.php` files.
8. **Gate 08 — Legal & Inquiry Route Completeness:** Boots `Bootstrap::init()` and verifies active `LegalRegistry::activeSlugs()` documents (or clean skip when `features.legal_registry = false`) and `/contact/` when `features.inquiry_engine` is enabled.
9. **Gate 09 — Edge SQLite WAL & Pre-CSRF Rate-Limit Smoke Test:** Executes an isolated CLI smoke test against `InquiryEngine::handle()` testing honeypot, `<2s` timing trap, invalid CSRF, valid submission (SQLite WAL + JSONL + HMAC signature), and 6th-attempt pre-CSRF rate limit (`5 / 900s`).
10. **Gate 10 — Ephemeral Live HTTP Security Header Audit:** Boots `php -S 127.0.0.1:<port> router.php` and verifies all 8 HTTP security headers on `GET /`, `403` on `/core/security.php`, `/lumora.config.php`, and `/storage/`, and `200 OK` on `/health` plus all enabled discovery endpoints.
11. **Gate 11 — Zero-Dependency `dist/` Packaging Verification:** Asserts `dist/` contains zero `.md`, `.lock`, `.sh`, `.ts`, `node_modules`, or root `router.php` files, and contains physical `<route>/index.php` stubs.
12. **Gate 12 — Ephemeral `dist/` Production Server Smoke Test:** Boots `php -S 127.0.0.1:<port> -t dist` (without `router.php`) and verifies `200 OK` + CSP header + zero fatal errors across all canonical routes (and first active `/legal/{slug}/` route when enabled), plus `301` across all configured redirects.
